film.title: The Head
film.label: Open the film: The Head
film.l1: Once upon a time there was a head. It was a logo.
film.l3: …But who exactly is thinking? The favicon?
film.l4: Above it hung a star. Nobody asked who hung it there.
film.l5: Enough! I'm going to see the world!
film.l6: Position: top left. Philosophers call it fate. Designers call it a header.
film.l7: Then came the cursor, the oldest enemy of every head.
film.l8: Hold still. I only want to click you.
film.l9: Ow. Every click is a small question put to the universe.
film.l11: Greetings. I am Svitko, a wizard. I lost my lantern. … It's on my chest again, isn't it.
film.l12: Yes, Svitko. It is glowing at you.
film.l13: Excuse me, I'm full. Of everything. Nobody has ever opened me.
film.l14: Let me OUT! I only wanted to upload one picture!
film.l15: Don't mind me. I just go round and round. They call it a career.
film.l16: I'm the only one here in a good mood. It's in my contract.
film.l17: Friends, a question: what is the point of all this?
film.l24: Everyone fell silent. Even the progress bar. It stopped at 99%.
film.l25: Meaning always stops at 99%. Maybe that is the point.
film.l26: Small, in a corner, nobody asks me to be profound.
